local: À toi nos cœurs, à toi nos bras,
À toi notre sang, ô Patrie !
Nous le jurons tous, tu vivras !
english: To you our hearts, to you our arms,
To you our blood, O Fatherland!
We all swear, you shall live!

local: Tu vivras toujours grande et belle
Le Roi, la Loi, la Liberté !
english: You shall always live great and beautiful,
Shall have as an immortal motto:

local: Le Roi, la Loi, la Liberté !
